boundaries.label: Browser · existing P11 Save / Publish remain explicit

cards.title: Approved design · local implementation
items: Human selected OpenAI and gpt-6.1-sol; model and limits come from a project TOML file, not environment variables.
Human directed implementation with gpt-6.1-sol and file configuration. Local adapter is disabled; no credentials, live request, paid verification or deployment.
Use the existing API process; no evaluation worker, new store, migration or publication ledger.

cards.title: Data and execution boundary
items: Send only entered mission description (up to 2,000 characters), fixed supported-check schema and generic instructions.
Do not send project/user identifiers, stored artifacts, logs, telemetry or the whole suite. Server credentials never reach the browser.
One synchronous request; 30-second deadline; 2,048 output tokens; store:false; no tools or automatic retries. Bound API-process concurrency; no global quota claim.
Proposed TOML config: gpt-6.1-sol, low reasoning, standard service tier. Credentials referenced through a private owner-only key file; never tracked or sent to the browser.

cards.title: Preserve draft and publication authority
items: Release the database transaction during the external request; reauthorize and compare the saved version before returning.
Reject unsupported kinds, fields, IDs, versions, units and bounds. Explain unsupported requirements rather than inventing measurements.
Browser guards every acceptance with saved version plus local edit generation. Only the existing P11 Save / Publish path persists changes.
